newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea offers to sell dlrs in forward trade.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea offers to sell dlrs in forward trade.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea was seen offering to sell dollars in forward trading late Tuesday afternoon to slow the won's fall against the U.S. unit, traders said.
The central bank offered to sell $30 million each at 892.00 won in three-month forward trading and at 906.00 won in six-month forward trading, they said.
The central bank denied the talk of intervention as it routinely does.
Shortly after the offer, the won was trading at 878.30 against the dollar, against an opening rate of 876.00.
